تشاوظت (form VI)
# تَشَاوَظْتُ (tašāwaẓtu) /ta.ʃaː.waðˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَشَاوَظَ (tašāwaẓa)
# تَشَاوَظْتَ (tašāwaẓta) /ta.ʃaː.waðˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَشَاوَظَ (tašāwaẓa)
# تَشَاوَظْتِ (tašāwaẓti) /ta.ʃaː.waðˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَاوَظَ (tašāwaẓa)
# تَشَاوَظَتْ (tašāwaẓat) /ta.ʃaː.wa.ðˤat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
